blocks.text: Group 2 ke elements periodic table ke Group 2 mein s-block elements hain. Inhen alkaline earth metals bhi kehte hain, kyunke yeh metal (dhaat) hain aur zameen ki upar wali teh (earth crust) mein milte hain. In ki reactivity bohat zyada reactive alkali metals aur kam reactive transition metals ke darmiyan hai. Ca aur Mg earth crust mein sab se zyada milne wale aath elements mein shamil hain.
Tasveer ke neeche likha hai: fireworks (aatish baazi) ke zyada tar rang Group 2 elements ki wajah se hote hain.

Be ko copper ke alloys (mili-juli dhaaten) sakht banane ke liye istemal kiya jata hai, jo aerospace (hawai jahaz aur khala ke saman) mein kaam aate hain. Mg chlorophyll ka ahem hissa hai, yani paudon ka hara madda. Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba apne chamakdar flame colours (shole ke rang) ki wajah se fireworks (aatish baazi) mein zaroor istemal hote hain.

In sab elements ke sab se bahar wale 's' subshell mein do electrons (ns²) hain, is liye in ki chemical properties milti julti hain. Phir bhi group mein upar se neeche jate hue properties badalti hain. Group 2 ki ahem properties (khoobiyan) Table 17.1 mein di gayi hain. Melting point aur density ka trend is baat se juda hai ke group mein neeche metal atoms alag alag tareeqe se pack hote (jude hote) hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko upar se neeche parhein: Be se Ba tak atom aur ion ka size barhta hai (112 se 222 pm), aur 1st aur 2nd ionization energy kam hoti hai (900 se 503 kJ/mol). Is ka matlab hai ke neeche wale elements apne do bahar wale electrons aasani se de dete hain. Kitab ne ionization energy ki unit nahi likhi; yeh kJ/mol hai, aur E° ki unit volt (V) hai.

blocks.prompt: Group 2 ke kis element ki 1st ionization energy sab se zyada hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Beryllium (900 kJ/mol). Is ke bahar wale electrons nucleus ke sab se qareeb hain aur in par shielding (andar ke electrons ka parda) sab se kam hai, is liye inhen nikalna sab se mushkil hai.

items: Group 2 = alkaline earth metals, s-block, bahar ka configuration ns².
Reactivity alkali metals se kam aur transition metals se zyada.
Group mein neeche: size barhta hai, ionization energy aur electronegativity kam hoti hai.
